vhits.entry.title: Hits over many matches
vhits.entry.hint: Load only the hits on vehicles from a whole folder of War Thunder or DCS World matches or IL-2 mission reports, and read each plate of a vehicle: what struck it, how often it went through, at what speed and angle, and what that did.
vhits.load.title: Vehicle hits from many matches
vhits.load.hint: Pick War Thunder or DCS World matches (.3dheat containers or converted tables) or IL-2 mission reports (missionReport(...)[n].txt, a mission's pieces read as one). Only the hit rows and the columns the analysis uses are read; everything else stays in the files.
vhits.load.fromMassTitle: The War Thunder matches the Mass analysis has open, with its filter
vhits.load.poseTitle: Reads the victims' turret yaw and gun elevation, so hits on a turned turret land on its plates at rest. Costs a little more reading.

vhits.load.stopped: Stopped at the memory ceiling: {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} left unread. Narrow the selection (a map, a mode, dates) to load the rest.

vhits.field.angleTitle: Between the shell's way and the plate's normal at the hit, 0 square on. From the recorded direction and the model's plate (turret pose applied).
vhits.field.speedTitle: A ballistic estimate: the shell's muzzle speed (your install's catalogue, else its kind's) less the drag over the distance
vhits.field.descentTitle: Below the horizontal at the hit: recorded (in the vehicle's frame) where the replay has the shell's way, else the ballistic arc's
vhits.field.distanceTitle: From the shooter's position at the hit to the hit point
vhits.field.effMmTitle: The plate's thickness over the cosine of the impact angle
